replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: this was a genuine deviation and a partial refund is due. It is not an escalation.

THE ROUTE. The GPS trace governs the measurement (POL-RD-01), not the trip record's rounded copy: 23.97 km driven against an 18.0 km platform optimal — an excess of 5.97 km, 33.2% of optimal. Both establishment gates are passed (over 20%, over 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. Neither materiality gate is passed (over 50%, or over 8.0 km), so this is not a MATERIAL deviation: the POL-RD-06 driver-conduct check and its referral are not engaged, and on its own terms the pattern test fails anyway (deviation_flags_90d = 1 against completed_trips_90d = 412, neither 3 or more nor a 0.05 ratio).

WHY NOTHING EXONERATES IT. POL-RD-03 needs an LTA traffic_advisory naming a road the optimal route uses, with a validity window covering the passage. EV-ADVIS-00114-01 is MISSING — payload null, status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, flagged BLOCKING — and no advisory covers the AYE, PIE or Alexandra corridor in the 18:36–19:20 window. Without that artifact POL-RD-03 has no predicate and cannot run. POL-RD-04 does not apply: the only rider message ('adam road?? jurong is the other way', 18:58:40) is a query sent after the vehicle had already left the optimal corridor, carries no waypoint_hint and names no road, so it is not a rider instruction and nothing is excluded from the excess; the driver's reply supplies no waypoint either. POL-RD-05 fails (no amended endpoints, so no re-quote), POL-RD-12 fails (vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL), and POL-RD-11 does not displace the arithmetic (fare_model METERED, quoted_fare_sgd null). The deviation stands.

WHY THIS IS NOT AN ESCALATION. It was argued that the absent advisory should hold the case. It should not. The driver's congestion account ('AYE was crawling from the Alexandra exit…') is a bare assertion: it cites no evidence ID, names no clause and names no artifact, and the driver himself concedes 'No advisory that I know of'. POL-RD-08 provides that a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge the driver's burden and is discarded. POL-RD-10(5) escalates only where an exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing; no exculpatory clause is invoked against any cited artifact here — the driver's own case expressly disclaims POL-RD-03 exoneration. Nothing rests on an impaired artifact: the trace is clean (241 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps, max gap 0 s), so POL-RD-07 is not engaged and no independent corroboration is required. An LTA advisory covering the AYE/PIE/Alexandra corridor for that window would have been the evidence that resolved this; its absence supports the finding rather than blocking it.

THE MONEY. Charged total: SGD 58.10. Recomputed fare under POL-RD-02: ((3.80 + 0.75 × 18.0 + 0.28 × 30.0) × 1.6) + 0.80 platform fee + 2.50 on-optimal-route ERP = 41.12 + 0.80 + 2.50 = SGD 44.42. Refund: 58.10 − 44.42 = 13.68, rounded up to SGD 13.70. The surge multiplier of 1.6 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and applied to base, distance and time only, never to ERP; the rider accepted the surge, and the recomputation carries it, which is why the figure is 1.30 short of the 15.00 contested. On the ERP, the 2.00 Adam Road gantry is off-route and is already comprehended in this refund (POL-RD-09(1)) — it is itemised for transparency and is not added on top; the 2.50 Kim Keat Link gantry lies on the optimal route and stays with the ride. The trace passes within 250 m of both, so neither is a phantom line and there is no billing-integrity referral. 13.70 is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of the charge.

CONFIDENCE AND CAP. The deciding facts are carried by the trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown, all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is stated at 0.90. The MISSING advisory is disclosed in the reasoning above; it carries no fact and does not cap the ruling, though its absence is itself citable. No clause produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty.
